title: Satan
definition: Satan is the personal adversary who steals, kills, destroys, deceives, accuses, and opposes God’s work.
summary: Satan is the personal adversary who steals, kills, destroys, deceives, accuses, and opposes God’s work.
christFocus: Jesus came to destroy the works of the devil, disarm the powers, and give abundant life to His sheep.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Satan recognizes spiritual reality while keeping God, not the spiritual realm, at the center. Satan is dangerous but limited, defeated, and never equal to god.

Scripture speaks soberly about angels, demons, Satan, and unseen conflict, but it refuses fear, obsession, and speculation. People under addiction, accusation, spiritual fear, or despair may experience the enemy’s lies as if they are final truth.

Christ is supreme over every spiritual being and power. Jesus came to destroy the works of the devil, disarm the powers, and give abundant life to His sheep. Believers stand in His victory through Scripture, prayer, faith, and the power of the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Spiritual reality affects real life, but Scripture keeps the believer from fear and fascination. People under addiction, accusation, spiritual fear, or despair may experience the enemy’s lies as if they are final truth. The unseen realm must be understood under the rule of God and the victory of Christ.

It also protects against spiritual confusion. Angels are servants, demons are defeated enemies, Satan is limited, and Christ alone is worthy of trust and worship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Resist the devil by clinging to Christ, Scripture, prayer, truth, repentance, and faithful community. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
